title: juglans microcarpa var. stewartii
intro: Juglans microcarpa var. stewartii, commonly known as Stewart's chinquapin, is a variant of the chinquapin, a species of deciduous shrub or small tree in the family Juglandaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The health benefits of Juglans microcarpa var. stewartii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-microbial activities.
